description: Return the full agent roster of a brokerage. Pass brokerage_id (UUID) OR brokerage_slug OR (brokerage_name + state). Useful for queries like 'show me Compass agents in Charleston' or 'who are the top producers at this firm'.

limit.description: 1-100, default 25. Sorted by Flika score descending.

state.description: Two-letter state code (required if using brokerage_name).

name: scout.team_roster
